activeSlice.scope: Reduce real GitHub discovery rate-limit pressure by caching recent identical repository searches in the production GitHub discovery provider. Reuse only verified normalized evidence for a bounded TTL and bounded entry count; do not alter Hunter comparability or rollout thresholds.
successCriteria: Identical GitHub discovery queries within five minutes reuse normalized verified evidence without a second GitHub API request.
Different GitHub queries remain isolated cache entries.
The GitHub discovery cache is bounded to 64 entries by default and at most 500 entries by configuration.
Expired entries are fetched fresh and replaced.
Cached results are cloned on read/write so callers cannot mutate provider cache state.
No Hunter V1 comparability predicate or rollout threshold changes.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
The corrected 3x3 pre-gate passes on the exact merge SHA before any 30-pair gate.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: The paired persisted control still hit GitHub discovery rate limiting on the final attempt despite producing 16 evidence items, one measured model judgment and three recommendations. The retry was honestly metered at 39.958s and $0.0294871; comparability correctly remained fail-closed.
